name: oxo-flow-rnaseq
title: RNA-seq with STAR + gene/isoform counts
description: nf-core's flagship bulk RNA-seq pipeline: FastQC, trimming, STAR alignment with gene/isoform-level quantification via featureCounts/RSEM, QC with RSeQC and dupRadar, and MultiQC aggregation. The default STAR+featureCounts path is a linear DAG with per-sample fan-out and a single fan-in — a textbook fit for oxo-flow wildcard expansion.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> trimGalore -> STAR align -> featureCounts/RSEM counts -> RSeQC/dupRadar QC -> MultiQC (~14 rules)
rationale: The most-used nf-core pipeline (1349 stars, pushed 2026-08-12) and the canonical bulk RNA-seq reference used in hundreds of papers, whose default STAR+featureCounts chain maps cleanly onto oxo-flow's sample-wildcard DAG patterns.

name: oxo-flow-sarek
title: WGS/WES germline and somatic variant calling
description: The standard pipeline for germline and somatic variant detection (GATK best practices: BWA-MEM2 mapping, MarkDuplicates, BQSR, HaplotypeCaller/Mutect2) plus VEP/ANNOVAR annotation. Its tumor-normal structure matches oxo-flow's [[pairs]] machinery directly, and the gallery's wgs-germline example already proves the pattern.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> TrimGalore -> BWA-MEM2 -> MarkDuplicates -> BQSR -> HaplotypeCaller -> VEP -> MultiQC (~12 rules)
rationale: The de-facto clinical WGS/WES reference pipeline (592 stars, pushed 2026-08-13) whose germline default chain extends oxo-flow's existing germline gallery example with production-grade annotation.

name: oxo-flow-scrnaseq
title: Single-cell RNA-seq (10x / DropSeq / SmartSeq)
description: nf-core's single-cell RNA-seq pipeline supporting barcode-based protocols (10x, DropSeq, SmartSeq) with Cell Ranger or STARsolo/Alevin counting and scRNA-seq QC. The per-sample count rules are a simple fan-out that exercises oxo-flow sample_pattern discovery on cellranger-style directories.
scope: Default main path: input check -> cellranger count (per sample) -> multiqc aggregation (~8 rules)
rationale: The leading nf-core single-cell pipeline (349 stars, pushed 2026-08-05) that pairs with the existing single-cell gallery example while adding Cell Ranger protocol support.

name: oxo-flow-mag
title: Metagenome assembly and binning
description: Assembly and binning of metagenomes: QC, assembly with MEGAHIT, binning with MetaBAT2, CheckM/GTDB-Tk evaluation and classification. The QC->assembly->binning->taxonomy chain is a clean 4-stage pipeline with per-sample parallelism ideal for oxo-flow sample groups.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> fastp -> MEGAHIT assembly -> MetaBAT2 binning -> GTDB-Tk classify -> MultiQC (~10 rules)
rationale: The dominant metagenome assembly pipeline (314 stars, pushed 2026-08-14) with heavy paper usage, whose QC-to-binning-to-taxonomy default path is a compact DAG well within oxo-flow expressiveness.

name: oxo-flow-ampliseq
title: Amplicon sequencing (16S/ITS) with DADA2 and QIIME2
description: Amplicon sequencing analysis (16S/18S/ITS) using DADA2 denoising with optional QIIME2 downstream analysis and taxonomic classification. The DADA2 default path (trim -> denoise -> taxonomy -> barplot) is short and linear — an easy first port that demonstrates microbiome analysis in oxo-flow.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> cutadapt -> DADA2 denoise -> taxonomy assignment -> barplots -> MultiQC (~8 rules)
rationale: The most-used amplicon pipeline (256 stars, pushed 2026-08-13), widely cited in microbiome papers, and a short default path that makes an approachable mid-complexity template.

name: oxo-flow-chipseq
title: ChIP-seq peak calling, QC and differential analysis
description: ChIP-seq peak-calling and QC: alignment with BWA-MEM, peak calling with MACS2, irreproducible discovery rate (IDR) analysis and differential binding. Its per-replicate fan-out with consensus-peak fan-in demonstrates oxo-flow's scatter-gather transform pattern at production scale.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> trimGalore -> BWA-MEM -> MarkDuplicates -> MACS2 callpeak -> IDR -> MultiQC (~10 rules)
rationale: The standard ChIP-seq pipeline (242 stars, pushed 2026-07-27) whose replicate-to-consensus-peak structure showcases oxo-flow's scatter-gather semantics.

name: oxo-flow-atacseq
title: ATAC-seq peak calling and QC
description: ATAC-seq peak calling and QC with BWA-MEM alignment, fragment/read filtering, MACS2 peak calling with Tn5 shift handling, and quality metrics. The default single-end path is a lean linear chain that complements chipseq in the epigenetics trio.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> trimGalore -> BWA-MEM -> markdup/filter -> MACS2 -> QC plots -> MultiQC (~9 rules)
rationale: The reference ATAC-seq pipeline (226 stars, pushed 2026-07-25) completing the ChIP/ATAC/methyl epigenetics coverage of the library.

name: oxo-flow-methylseq
title: Bisulfite methylation analysis with Bismark
description: Methylation (bisulfite sequencing) analysis using Bismark alignment, deduplication and methylation extraction, with optional bwa-meth/MethylDackel routes. The bismark -> dedup -> methylextract -> report chain is short and linear, ideal for demonstrating per-rule conda environments in oxo-flow.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> trimGalore -> Bismark align -> dedup -> methylation extract -> Bismark report -> MultiQC (~8 rules)
rationale: The primary WGBS methylation pipeline (197 stars, pushed 2026-08-11) completing the epigenetics trio with a low-complexity linear port.

name: oxo-flow-nanoseq
title: Nanopore demultiplexing, QC and alignment
description: Nanopore demultiplexing, QC and alignment pipeline using Dorado/Guppy demultiplexing, pycoQC metrics and minimap2 alignment for downstream analysis. The demux -> QC -> align default path is one of the shortest DAGs in the library — a gentle entry template.
scope: Default main path: input check -> Dorado demultiplex -> pycoQC -> minimap2 align -> MultiQC (~6 rules)
rationale: The canonical nanopore pipeline (228 stars, pushed 2026-07-27) that adds long-read coverage to a mostly short-read library at minimal porting cost.

name: oxo-flow-viralrecon
title: Viral assembly and intrahost variant calling
description: Assembly and intrahost/low-frequency variant calling for viral samples (e.g. SARS-CoV-2): host read removal, SPAdes assembly, iVar variant calling and consensus generation. The assembly -> variant -> consensus -> annotation chain is a compact DAG with per-sample fan-out, well-suited to oxo-flow.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> fastp -> host removal -> SPAdes -> iVar variant call -> consensus -> MultiQC (~12 rules)
rationale: The most-cited viral genomics pipeline (167 stars, pushed 2026-08-06), heavily used during the pandemic and a strong fit for oxo-flow's per-sample DAG semantics.

name: oxo-flow-eager
title: Ancient DNA analysis (aDNA)
description: A state-of-the-art ancient DNA pipeline: adapter removal and UDG treatment handling, BWA-aln mapping, damage profiling (DamageProfiler), PMD filtering and genotyping. The damage-aware mapping chain is distinctive in the library and demonstrates environment-isolated legacy tools in oxo-flow.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> fastp -> AdapterRemoval -> BWA aln -> dedup -> DamageProfiler -> pileup genotyping -> MultiQC (~12 rules)
rationale: The leading ancient-DNA pipeline (212 stars, pushed 2026-08-07) used in aDNA studies worldwide, bringing a distinctive damage-aware domain to the library.

name: oxo-flow-fetchngs
title: Fetch metadata and FASTQ from public databases
description: Pipeline to fetch metadata and raw FASTQ files from public databases (SRA, ENA, GEO) given a samplesheet, including automatic FastQ download and QC. The fetch utility slot makes the library useful as a front-end companion for every other template.
scope: Default main path: samplesheet check -> metadata fetch -> FastQ download -> FastQC -> MultiQC (~6 rules)
rationale: The standard data-fetch companion (200 stars, pushed 2026-08-14) filling the QC/fetch utility niche while being one of the cheapest ports in the set.

name: oxo-flow-rnaseq-star-deseq2
title: RNA-seq with STAR and DESeq2 (snakemake catalog flagship)
description: The flagship snakemake-workflows catalog entry: RNA-seq alignment with STAR followed by DESeq2 differential expression. Porting it gives the same-domain cross-engine comparison that demonstrates oxo-flow's engine neutrality against the most-starred snakemake workflow.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> STAR index -> STAR align -> sort -> featureCounts -> DESeq2 (~7 rules)
rationale: The most-used catalog snakemake workflow (370 stars, pushed 2025-12-18) that anchors the snakemake half of the library and proves cross-engine parity on the flagship RNA-seq domain.

name: oxo-flow-varlociraptor
title: Small and structural variant calling with Varlociraptor
description: A snakemake-workflows catalog pipeline calling small and structural variants under any scenario (germline, tumor-normal), using GATK preprocessing plus Varlociraptor's event modeling. It adds the structural-variant niche with a very recent 2026-08-14 push.
scope: Default main path: FastQC -> mapping -> GATK preprocessing -> Varlociraptor call -> annotation (~8 rules)
rationale: The structural-variant specialist (90 stars, pushed 2026-08-14) from the snakemake catalog that is actively developed and fills the SV coverage target.

name: oxo-flow-snparcher
title: Variant calling for non-model organisms
description: A snakemake catalog workflow for highly parallel variant calling in non-model organisms, with optional de novo assembly and easy sample-sheet configuration. It broadens the library beyond human/clinical pipelines into ecology and crop genomics.
scope: Default main path: sample sheets -> trimmomatic -> BWA-MEM -> GATK HaplotypeCaller -> filtering (~9 rules)
rationale: The top non-model-organism variant calling workflow (95 stars, pushed 2026-07-29) that extends the library to ecology and non-human genomics.

name: oxo-flow-enrichment
title: Genomic region set and gene set enrichment
description: A snakemake catalog workflow and MrBiomics module for genomic region set and gene set enrichment analyses (rGREAT, clusterProfiler). As a post-analysis template it chains onto any peak-calling or DE output and demonstrates lightweight R-rule patterns in oxo-flow.
scope: Default main path: input region/gene sets -> enrichment test -> multiple-test correction -> plots/report (~6 rules)
rationale: The most-used functional enrichment workflow in the snakemake catalog (77 stars, pushed 2026-08-03) that supplies the post-analysis niche the library otherwise lacks.

name: oxo-flow-genome-tracks
title: Genome browser track generation from BAM files
description: A snakemake catalog workflow for easy visualization of genome browser tracks from aligned BAM files (coverage, bigWig generation, track plotting). A concrete utility template whose per-sample BAM-to-bigwig steps are trivially expressible with oxo-flow wildcards.
scope: Default main path: BAM input -> optional dedup -> deepTools coverage -> bigWig -> track plot (~6 rules)
rationale: The genome-browser track utility (57 stars, pushed 2025-08-05) from the maintained MrBiomics ecosystem that fills the visualization niche.

name: oxo-flow-mixscape
title: Pooled CRISPR perturbation analysis (Mixscape)
description: A snakemake catalog workflow for performing perturbation analyses of pooled CRISPR screens (Seurat + Mixscape): QC, normalization, integration, mixscape classification and perturbation DE. It brings the functional-genomics screening niche into the library.
scope: Default main path: count matrix input -> QC/normalization -> integration -> Mixscape classification -> perturbation DE (~7 rules)
rationale: The pooled-CRISPR perturbation workflow (56 stars, pushed 2025-12-07) from the active MrBiomics suite, cited alongside Perturb-seq methodology and covering a domain no other candidate offers.

name: oxo-flow-bgcflow
title: Biosynthetic gene cluster analysis across genomes
description: A snakemake catalog workflow for analyzing biosynthetic gene clusters across large collections of genomes: annotation, antiSMASH detection, and pangenome-scale BGC comparison. It covers the microbial genomics target with a distinctive natural-products angle.
scope: Default main path: genomes input -> annotation -> antiSMASH -> BGC comparison -> report (~6 rules)
rationale: The biosynthetic gene cluster workflow (55 stars, pushed 2026-05-16) from the NBDC/NBChub ecosystem, published in the BGC field and the library's microbial-genomics natural-products entry.

name: oxo-flow-unsupervised
title: Unsupervised analyses of omics matrices
description: A general-purpose snakemake catalog workflow for unsupervised analyses (dimensionality reduction, clustering, visualization) of feature/observation matrices from any omics platform. It provides the library's generic downstream-stats template usable after any quantification pipeline.
scope: Default main path: matrix input -> preprocessing -> PCA -> UMAP -> clustering -> plots (~7 rules)
rationale: The actively maintained general-purpose unsupervised analysis module (67 stars, pushed 2026-08-03) that rounds out the snakemake half with a platform-agnostic statistics template.
